subject: VPC + IAM deep-dive: availability, agenda, and materials
messages:
From: Rachel Meyer <rmeyer@orchidhealth.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.wu@orchidhealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC & IAM deep-dive request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the overview earlier this week. Our infra and security teams have asked for a technical deep-dive focused on VPC connectivity, egress controls, and IAM/SSO integration before we sign off on Dedicated capacity.

High-level ask: 90-minute session with AE + SE + our platform and security engineers (Tom & Rachel), plus procurement on the call to confirm contract/controls. Can you share availability next week (Mar 22–25)? We also have a preliminary network diagram — attaching in my next message.

We'd like the session to cover:
- Network topology and VPN/VPC peering options
- Traffic egress and data flow (what leaves the VPC)
- IAM model, SCIM/SSO support, and key management integrations
- Audit logging and retention options (S3/Log exports)

Thanks —
Rachel Meyer
Director, Cloud Ops | Orchid Health
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Meyer <rmeyer@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC & IAM deep-dive request

Rachel — great to hear, happy to run this. Sean (SE) and Aisha (solutions/security) will join.

Availability from our side next week:
- Tue Mar 23: 09:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Mar 24: 13:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Mar 25: 08:30–10:00 PT (shorter window)

Proposed agenda (90 min):
1) 10m intros + objectives
2) 25m serving/runtime + network topology options (SE)
3) 25m IAM/SSO/SCIM + KMS options (Aisha)
4) 20m audit logs, retention, and evidence (compliance)
5) 10m Q&A and next steps + procurement checklist

Can you confirm which slot you prefer and whether procurement (procurement@orchidhealth.com) should be on the invite or looped separately?

Also please share that network diagram and any compliance checklist items (SOC 2 evidence, data residency constraints) you want us to prepare. I can attach a brief SOC2 summary and our standard deep-dive agenda to the invite.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VPC & IAM deep-dive request

Adding a few technical notes ahead of Wed's session so we can target the demo.

Quick checklist we plan to cover from the SE side:
- VPC connectivity modes: VPC peering vs. managed VPN vs. PrivateLink — pros/cons for cross-region egress
- Egress characteristics: source IP behavior, egress NAT, and options for restricting outbound endpoints
- KV cache/streaming considerations for on-prem sequencing (latency SLOs)
- SCIM: provisioning attributes we require (email, username, role mapping) and SCIM rate limits

Can you attach the Okta connector configuration (or a screenshot of provisioning mapping) if it's convenient? That will help us prepare a short demo of user provisioning and permission mapping.

I'll bring a short runnable demo (no customer keys) showing a SCIM user creation flow and how roles map to Redwood's model.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

2) Data retention and log export details (how long, format, where exported)
3) Any subprocessing network (third-party telemetry endpoints) list

If you can share a redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and confirm export destinations (S3 bucket options), that will expedite internal approvals.

From: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, rmeyer@orchidhealth.com, tom.wu@orchidhealth.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC & IAM deep-dive request — procurement items

Hi — attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a one-pager on log export/retention options.

Attachments: [redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page), deepdive-agenda-v1.docx]

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Type II report available under NDA; summary attached includes auditor and scope.
- Log export: we support S3 export to a customer-owned bucket or push to an S3 staging bucket; retention is configurable (30/90/365 days) — we'll include recommended defaults in the session.
- Third-party endpoints: runtime telemetry is optional; by default no external telemetry is sent without customer opt-in. We'll enumerate any defaults in the deep-dive.

Mateo will send the calendar invite for Wed Mar 24 13:00 PT with the agenda and materials. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Solutions & Compliance, Redwood Inference
